item.title: Jesus the Cornerstone: Stability in Christ Alone
item.description: In this devotional episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue teaches from Scripture that Jesus Christ alone is the cornerstone and foundation of our faith. Drawing from 1 Corinthians 3:11 and related passages, this message calls Christians to repent of misplaced trust and rest fully in Christ—the unchanging foundation who secures our faith through every trial.

item.title: Job 26: The God Who Rules the Storm and Sustains His People
item.description: Job 26 reveals God’s power over creation, the storm, and the grave, reminding believers that the sovereign Lord faithfully sustains His people.

item.title: Living Anchored for a Lifetime: Growing in Grace by Abiding in Christ
item.description: In this final episode of the Anchored for a New Year series on Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins calls believers to a lifelong pattern of growth rooted not in self-effort, but in abiding in Christ. Drawing from John 15, Colossians 2:6–7, Galatians 2:20, and 2 Peter 3:18, this episode explains why true discipleship flows from union with Christ, not striving in the flesh.
